theme.title: The Numbers Game

questions.prompt: Chicago routed Utah in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals. By how many points did the Bulls win?
questions.note: 42 points, a Finals record for margin of defeat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In a 96–54 loss, the Jazz set the record for the 42-point loss in Finals history

funFacts.text: Every player on Chicago's roster scored at least once in the rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Every player on the Bulls roster scored at least once

funFacts.text: Utah had beaten Chicago in both regular-season meetings that year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Jazz had won both regular season meetings with the Bulls

funFacts.text: The Jazz reached the Finals by sweeping the Lakers in the West finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Jazz uneventfully swept the Los Angeles Lakers

questions.prompt: LeBron James took 38 shots in Game 1 of the 2015 Finals. In his 100-point game, how many shots did Wilt Chamberlain take?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Playing all 48 minutes of the game, Chamberlain set NBA records for field goals attempted (63) and made (36)

funFacts.text: That night was never televised; the surviving recording is a radio call from the final quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was not televised, and no video footage of the game has been recovered

funFacts.text: New York began intentionally fouling other Warriors to prevent Wilt from getting the ball in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

funFacts.text: Wilt set a free-throw record despite his reputation as an unreliable shooter from the line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain set five other league records that game, including most free throws made

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other guard scoring nights. How many points did Steph Curry score against the Knicks at MSG in 2013?
